summary:
Rula Lenska is a British actress best known for British stage and television roles, U.S. hair-product advertisements in the 1970s and 1980s, and playing Claudia Colby in *Coronation Street*. Born in England in 1947 to a Polish noble family, she trained at the Webber-Douglas School of Drama and began acting at 18.

Her breakthrough came as “Q” in the television series *Rock Follies* (1976–77). Her Alberto VO5 commercials made her a subject of jokes in the United States, where she was little known. She continued working mainly in theatre, with roles in productions including *Blithe Spirit*, *Misery* and *Macbeth*. She returned to film in 2003 and joined *Coronation Street* in 2009, reprising Claudia at intervals through 2022.

Lenska published her autobiography, *Rula: My Colourful Life*, in 2013. She has one daughter from her first marriage and was also married to actor Dennis Waterman. Both marriages ended in divorce. In 2026, she was announced as a guest star in the forthcoming fourth series of *The Good Ship Murder*.
